forcing.after_end: zero applied specified value (also for + channels); final sample uses its table value
forcing.derivatives: with respect to scaled input T; +initial offset only at order zero; exact endpoints use the interior table polynomial on either side
forcing.local_jet: explicit frozen branch continuation; first-left undefined; end-right is zero rather than the legacy exact-end table value
limitations: ASWING spline endpoint conditions are unverified; natural cubic segments are used.
Zero-after-end applies to complete specified values; relative-channel cutoff still needs an ASWING executable comparison.

Inverse histories retain the trajectory equations and require consistent initialization. Cold initialization and a guarded saved Earth-velocity history launch are available; general saved transitions and compatible discontinuous events remain unfinished.
Periodic targets use the stated local principal chart. Table samples are not automatically unwrapped; multi-turn and branch-crossing initialization require explicit validation.
Source endpoint vacuum inertia and material damping with moving-frame transport. ASWING executable parity remains unverified.
BDF1/BDF2 discretize the material and Earth Euler angles in the published kinematic equations. Saved continuous angle branches are binding; singular or ambiguous charts are rejected.
Radau IIA is an OpenSwing continuous-equation extension, not the time discretization described in the ASWING paper.

Prescribed, free and mixed canonical frame loads are supported. Airflow, fluid inertia, controllers, actuator/history constraints, struts, engines and stepped axes remain unavailable for this source policy.
Time-step and mesh refinement remain necessary. Nonlinear convergence alone does not establish trajectory accuracy.

request.source:
! Independent mechanics check, not an archived ASWING validation case.
! Select ASWING moving-frame vacuum modes, free frame, zero gravity.
! EA/L = 100 N/m, endpoint masses 2 and 3 kg.
! The axial angular frequency is sqrt(100*(1/2+1/3)) rad/s.
! Request one mode near shift (-0.1, 9.128709291752768).
! Global rigid-body zero/Jordan chains are retained but not selected here.
Name
Free-frame axial oscillator
End
Unit
L 1 m
T 1 s
F 1 N
End
Constant
10 1.225 340
End
Reference
2 .2 2
End
Ground
1 1 0
End
Weight
1 1 0 0 0 20 0 0 0 0 0 10 15 20 0 0 0
1 3 0 2 0 30 0 0 0 0 0 12 18 24 0 0 0
End
Beam 1
Massless axial spring
t x y z chord
1 0 0 0 .2
3 0 2 0 .2
t EA EIcc GJ EInn GKc GKn
1 0 0 0 0 0 0
3 0 0 0 0 0 0
End
